meta: Why doesn't AI know yesterday's news? Ask AI about something new and it answers wrong, still sounding confident. The culprit is the knowledge cutoff.

muc.title: AI doesn't know yesterday's news
muc.text: Ask AI about yesterday's news and it answers wrong while sounding very sure. The culprit is called the knowledge cutoff.

muc.title: The data cutoff
muc.text: It's the date the training data stops: the last point the model, the AI's brain, learned from.

muc.title: Trained first, released later
muc.text: After training, a model still has to be tested before release, so the cutoff is usually a few months old.

muc.title: Turn on web search or paste the news
muc.text: For recent news, turn on web search or paste the article for AI to read, then check the publication date.

muc.title: Ask for the cutoff date
muc.text: Ask a chatbot for its knowledge cutoff date, then ask about something from this week.
